query: Consider the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Khronos and Khronos; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: Notwithstanding the foregoing, the rights and obligations set forth in Sections 4 (Confidential Information), 5.7 (No Warranty) and 5.8 (Limitation of Liability) will survive termination of this Agreement.
rag_answer: Yes. Section 5.9 (Termination) states that, notwithstanding termination, the rights and obligations set forth in Sections 4 (Confidential Information), 5.7 (No Warranty), and 5.8 (Limitation of Liability) will survive termination of the Agreement.

judge.gold_summary: 协议规定第4条（保密信息）、第5.7条（无保证）和第5.8条（责任限制）中的权利和义务在协议终止后继续有效。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称协议终止后，第4条（保密信息）、第5.7条（无保证）和第5.8条（责任限制）中的权利和义务继续有效。
